name: Get paid
tagline: Card payment on your quotes and invoices, straight to your bank

roadmap.note: Shipped for invoices and quote deposits via Stripe. Booking deposits follow. MakerBay adds no fee on top of Stripe's in this release.

marketing.summary: Connect your bank once through Stripe, and your invoices and accepted quotes grow a real Pay button. The money goes to your account, the invoice marks itself paid, and nobody has to read out card numbers over the phone.
marketing.audience: Any business tired of chasing bank transfers after the work is done.

features.title: Pay button on invoices
features.body: The invoice page your customer already has gains a Pay online button. Card, wallet - whatever Stripe supports in your country.

features.title: Deposits on accepted quotes
features.body: Set a deposit percentage and an accepted quote asks for it on the spot, while the customer is still saying yes.

features.title: Marks itself paid
features.body: When the money lands, the invoice flips to paid on its own - the webhook is the source of truth, never the button press.

faq.a: Stripe's standard processing fee, and nothing from us on top in this release. If that changes it will change for new payments, with notice, never retroactively.
Directly to the bank account you connect through Stripe. MakerBay never holds your funds.

faq.q: What if I have not connected Stripe?
faq.a: Then no pay buttons appear anywhere - your quotes and invoices work exactly as before. We never show a customer a button that does nothing.
